text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Oww...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the city with North Flight,
I saw Biko Pegasus take a fall—!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
! Biko...!
Are you okay...!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Flight-senpai...
It's fine, she'll be fine... but still—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: My can badge, and my pants...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed the hem of her pants frayed from the fall.
She said the Carrotman tin badge she was carrying got dirty as well.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see... The pin badge is a bit dirty, but it doesn't look scratched.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Next up are the trousers... Yep,
the frayed area doesn't look too big on these either.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true...?
C-Can we really manage somehow...!?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, certainly!
First, let's buy some safety pins at the convenience store.
We can do some first aid, and then head back to the academy, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following North Flight's instructions, after making a makeshift fix with a safety pin,
the three of us decided to head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
――Right then! Let's get right
to work on repairing these trousers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight had brought various tools,
including her own sewing kit. Which means—
choice_data_list: (I wonder if Flight will sew it for me?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan. Do you usually do any sewing?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not at all... I'm really
not that good with detailed, delicate work...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: In that case, let's use some mending cloth!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It refers to the patch of cloth used to cover frayed areas.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Unlike sewing, you can fix it simply
by applying iron-on mending fabric♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: And with that—here you go, Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Oh!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First, cut the repair patch
to match the size of the frayed area.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Once that's done, apply it to the lining
and iron it.
I'll warm up the iron for you♪"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright! Um... it's only frayed this much,
so something like this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight showed how it was done,
and Biko Pegasus put it into practice.
choice_data_list: (I see, having them put it into practice themselves.)
(I see, having them put it into practice themselves.)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Done! Amazing...!
I didn't know it was this easy to fix...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I think I might be able to do it myself next time...
Heheh! Thank you, Flight-senpai!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You're welcome. Let me know whenever you need a hand♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Thank you so much for letting us use your room, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "I'm so glad to see you smiling, Biko-chan♪"
choice_data_list: Looks like that helped her become more independent
Seems like that helped her become more independent, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight had previously given Hishi Miracle advice
to encourage her independence—and it seemed like
she had a similar intention this time as well.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you noticed.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I think the future will be so much brighter
if we help that person take action on their own♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her attitude of standing by someone while encouraging their independence.
Once again, I found myself deeply impressed by how wonderful that is."
choice_data_list: I'm sure that was a huge help.
You're such a kind person, huh.
You're such a kind person, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her attitude of standing by someone while encouraging their independence.
Once again, I found myself deeply impressed by how wonderful that is."
choice_data_list: I'm sure that was a huge help.
You're such a kind person, huh.
You're such a kind person, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told him that if I were in Biko Pegasus's shoes, I would have been deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'd be happy if that were the case.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If there's ever anything troubling you, Trainer,
please feel free to tell me anytime.
I'll do everything I can to help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It made me realize just how many girls
have surely been saved by Flight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told her that her dedication to staying by their side through thick and thin comes from her kindness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told her that her dedication to staying by their side through thick and thin comes from your kindness.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case—maybe it's because
my big sister used to do the same for me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"How to make the material known as 'me' shine,
how to maintain that sparkle myself—
I was taught all of it, after all."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If I can do the same things as my big sister,
that makes me super proud♪
